[PREFERENCE] User likes the sound of the Razer BlackWidow Chroma V2 but is unsure about the Romer-G switches.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Romer-G switches are tactile and clicky, with an actuation force of 45g, actuation distance of 1.9mm, total travel distance of 4mm, and a lifespan rated for 80 million keystrokes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cherry MX switches are the industry standard, with various variants and a lifespan rated for 50 million keystrokes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Main differences between Romer-G and Cherry MX switches include feel, sound, actuation distance, and durability.
